text:
[NDBG.13.6.1] In replay, the Agenda scope shows the firings still to
come in the current pump, in the order they fire ([LDET.5]). Each entry shows
the rule name, a bindings summary and the terminal ordinal. A trace records
firings, not activations, so an activation cancelled before it fires is not
shown. In a live session the scope is empty: a live stop falls after the pump
([NDBG.12.1.1]).
